description: Agent Accountability: submit an action or audit record design: each kind of action with how its record identifies the actor, the authorization, the permissions held and the time, plus whether permissions are enforced grants or instructions and whether grants keep earlier versions. The signed report names every recorded action that cannot be attributed to a specific agent acting under a specific authorization with specific permissions at that moment, and the missing field in each case. Run completeness is wever_run-record-check. Verdict unattributable_actions, attribution_unverified or attributable. POST /api/actor-attribution-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-accountability-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-accountability/.
